HeroSection.heroMessage: I build thoughtful web experiences with React & TypeScript.
HeroSection.aboutMessage: 👋 I’m Máté, a frontend engineer based in Pécs, Hungary. I have 3+ years of experience building web and mobile products, from banking and sports betting platforms to enterprise applications. I care about intuitive interfaces, maintainable code and products that feel good to use.

AboutSection.subTitle: 04 / ABOUT
AboutSection.title: A little more about me.
AboutSection.paragraph1: I'm a frontend engineer from Pécs, Hungary. What I enjoy most about development is taking an idea and turning it into something people can actually use.
AboutSection.paragraph2: React and TypeScript are where I'm most at home, but I'm curious about the whole product. I enjoy understanding how the backend works, experimenting with new technologies and building projects outside of work.
AboutSection.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, you'll probably find me gaming, cooking, working on some random project, or convincing myself that this side project will definitely be the one I finish.
